inventory.notes: Deletes the upstream update machinery (updater, MAR signature checks and channel IDs, maintenance service, update agent, bspatch). Hookable=hard: nothing is left to hook, and every upstream edit to these lines will conflict on rebase. The header comment says this was done on owner instruction and deliberately NOT as a --disable-updater switch. --enable-update-channel is kept: CONFIRMED, it lives in build/moz.configure/init.configure:1188 (not in this file, untouched). Default browser agent and notification server are kept (diff context). Open question from the first pass now CHECKED: toolkit/moz.build:45-46 builds toolkit/mozapps/update only when CONFIG['MOZ_UPDATER'] (and :48-50 builds mozapps/update/common when MOZ_MAINTENANCE_SERVICE or MOZ_UPDATER), browser/app/moz.build:79 also gates on it, and a grep of build/moz.configure and toolkit/moz.configure finds no other reference to MOZ_UPDATER or the removed options (only zucchini.configure keeps its own MOZ_ZUCCHINI option), so the comment's claim that the update directory is not built is CONFIRMED. Stillborn: this removes Firefox's own updater and its aus5 traffic.
